sources.snippet: ALBERT XLarge v2 Pretrained model on English language using a masked language modeling (MLM) objective. It was introduced in this paper and first released in this repository. This model, as all ALBERT models, is uncased: it does not make a difference between english and English.

sources.snippet: ALBERT is a transformers model pretrained on a large corpus of English data in a self-supervised fashion. This means it was pretrained on the raw texts only, with no humans labelling them in any way (which is why it can use lots of publicly available data) with an automatic process to generate inputs and labels from those texts. sources.snippet: ALBERT-xlarge-v2 for MindNLP This repository contains the ALBERT-xlarge-v2 model, adapted for use with the MindNLP library and the Huawei MindSpore framework. ALBERT (A Lite BERT) incorporates two parameter-reduction techniques—factorised embedding parameterisation and cross-layer parameter sharing—to overcome the memory limitations often associated with scaling transformer architectures.
